name: Taifoon × NEAR AI Cloud — one routed call, as NEAR's router makes it, and its settlement line

nodes.name: List models
nodes.notes: GET /v1/models with the key: the models the gate serves at the list price (the same list the registry discovers).

nodes.name: One call
nodes.notes: The call NEAR's router makes: model = providerConfig.model_name of a row workflow 20 wrote (the id on Taifoon's list).

nodes.name: Settlement line
nodes.notes: The line NEAR posts to its own settlement endpoint, computed from the usage the answer carries and the list price.
